Getting Started

Importing a programme

Click Import PDF and drop in an Asta Powerproject PDF export. The app reads the text layer and attempts to identify task ID, name, dates, duration, float, trade and floor. Review and correct the preview table, then confirm to add the tasks.

If parsing can't find structured rows, you'll see a warning — use manual task entry instead via "Add Task".

Defining floors & rooms

Open Floors & Rooms from the toolbar to add building levels and the rooms within each one.

Assigning tasks

Click any task bar to open its detail panel, then add Floors and Rooms from the dropdowns. A task can belong to more than one of each.

Floor View

Click Floor View to see a chosen floor's tasks laid out spatially. Twelve real General Arrangement drawings from the Stirling Building project are built in — levels B1, 00, 01, 02, 03, 05 and 06, plus all five North Pavilion sheets. Floors with a clear level match load their GA drawing automatically; pick any of the 12 manually from the drawing dropdown at any time.

Click Place Room, then click anywhere on the drawing to drop a room marker exactly there. Drag existing markers to reposition them. Markers turn green when a task assigned to that room is active in the current time window — click one to filter the task list, or click a listed task to jump straight to it.

Rooms without a GA sheet fall back to a simple grid layout. Set or change a floor's default drawing anytime from Floors & Rooms.

Filtering & fading

Use the left sidebar to filter by trade, floor, or date range. Non-matching tasks fade to 15% opacity rather than disappearing, so you keep the full programme's spatial context.

Zoom & navigation

Switch Day / Week / Month / Quarter views, use the zoom slider, or click Fit to scale the whole programme into view. Drag the amber box in the bottom overview bar to jump around long programmes.

Rescheduling

Drag a task bar left or right to reschedule it — dependent tasks shift automatically. Drag the small handles at each end to change duration. Undo with Ctrl+Z, redo with Ctrl+Y.

Saving your work

Everything is saved automatically to this browser, tied to this file. Use Export JSON to back up or share your programme, and Import JSON to restore it.

If you download an updated version of this file later, your browser may still show the older saved programme instead of the new one — that's expected, since local edits normally take priority over the built-in sample data. Use the reset icon next to Help (top right) to clear it and load the current built-in data fresh.
